title: Kaleidoscopic German Narutomaki Stir Fry
description: A vegan-friendly German stir fry featuring narutomaki, with a resinous and light flavor profile, perfect for show-off dishes. This recipe combines the best of German and Japanese cuisine.

ingredients.name: narutomaki
ingredients.notes: Japanese fish cake, sliced into thin rounds

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced narutomaki and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Pour in the vegan stir fry sauce and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with sliced green onions or sesame seeds if desired.
